sections.content_markdown: Example 12. Palash Sarker joined the job in January 2005 at a yearly salary of Tk. 120000. His yearly increment is Tk. 5000. 10% of his salary is deducted every year for provident fund. At the end of year he deposits 12000 Tk. in a bank at a compound interest of 12%. He will retire from the job on December 31, 2030.
1) Which series done the basic salary of Palash Sarker follow? Write down that series.
2) How much salary (in Tk.) would he receive in his entire job life excluding the provident fund money?
3) What is the amount of total deposited money with interest in the bank by December 31, 2031?

Solution:

1) Basic salary of Palash Sarker follows arithmetic series.
The first term of the series $a = 120000$ and common difference $= 5000$
$\therefore$ The second term $= 120000 + 5000 = 125000$
The third term $= 125000 + 5000 = 130000$
$\therefore$ The series is, $120000 + 125000 + 130000 + \dots$

2) The total amount of salary excluding the provident fund from January 2005 to December 31, 2030 i.e. $(2030 - 2005 + 1)$ or, 26 years is:
$(120000 - 10\% \text{ of } 120000) + (125000 - 10\% \text{ of } 125000) + (130000 - 10\% \text{ of } 130000) + \dots$
$= (120000 - 12000) + (125000 - 12500) + (130000 - 13000) + \dots$
$= 108000 + 112500 + 117000 + \dots$
In this case it is an arithmetic series whose first term, $a = 108000$, common difference $d = 112500 - 108000 = 4500$ and number of terms $n = 26$
$\therefore$ Total salary he receives in 26 years $= \frac{26}{2} \{2 \times 108000 + (26 - 1) \times 4500\}$ Tk.
$= 13(216000 + 112500) = 13 \times 328500 = 4270500 \text{ Tk.}$

3) Total time from 2005 to 2031 is $(2031 - 2005)$ or 26 years
Deposit of 12000 Tk. after 1 year $12000 \left(1 + \frac{12}{100}\right) = 12000 \times 1.12 \text{ Tk.}$
